notes: Mirage part cards (CPU, GPU, drives, memory, network) are drawn to the CEO own design (runes/part.js, now the default layout for every part rune): one row = the part name over a ring and the lead reading, with the other two readings beside…

A part name shortens instead of clipping: full model, then without its trademarks, then its first words, then the part itself (CPU); and it is written the way the machine reports it rather than in capitals.
